title: Ball Behind Rotating Billboard
name: ball_behind_rotating_billboard
description: A ball rolls from left to right at a steady speed while remaining in contact with the top of a straight raised rail. A large opaque billboard mounted at its center on a vertical post in front of the rail rotates clockwise as viewed from above, turning from edge-on to broadside and then edge-on again. The broadside panel fully hides the passing ball for a moment before the same ball reappears and continues at the same speed.
